$description: A burnt-orange accent on warm paper-and-espresso stone, pill buttons and the softest radii (28px cards), Fraunces serif headings over DM Sans, and gold warnings.

neutral.$description: Points at color.stone (design-system/tokens/primitives.tokens.json): Ember's warm stone, paper to espresso.

pull.$description: Fraunces' display cut already sets commas and full stops close to the letter before them; with the serif tracking, any pull makes the mark touch it.

sans.$description: DM Sans. UI and body copy.

heading.$description: Fraunces, an upright display serif with an optical-size axis, at the heading roles' 800 and 700. Body copy and UI stay in DM Sans.

brand-subtle.$description: One step stronger than the default: the 50 tint sits on top of the warning amber fill, so brand badges would read as warnings.

overlay.$description: A warm espresso scrim in place of 20% of the foreground, which reads as a cool grey over white and cream. Darkens the page by about as much.

violet.$description: The first tint follows the accent: pale peach.

sand.$description: Moved towards butter so it stays apart from the peach first tint.

sky.$description: Softer, so it sits on warm stone without reading icy.

rose.$description: Moved from coral towards pink so it stays apart from the peach first tint beside it.

4.$description: Plum in place of amber: amber sits too close to the orange first series, and the shared violet would read as the Blocks accent. A berry tone stays in Ember's warm, editorial palette and clear of the destructive red.

warning.$description: Ember moves warning from the shared amber (hue 72) to gold (hue 80), so an 'At risk' state never reads as the orange accent. Same meaning and contrast pairs.

warning-subtle.$description: Quiet warning fill, in Ember's gold.

panel-warning.$description: Warning on dark panels, in Ember's gold.

brand-subtle-foreground.$description: One step stronger than the default so brand badges read orange on the dark ember fill, like the status badges beside them.

4.$description: Plum in place of amber, lifted for the dark canvas: amber sits too close to the orange first series, and the shared violet would read as the Blocks accent.

warning.$description: Ember moves warning from the shared amber (hue 72) to gold (hue 80), so an 'At risk' state never reads as the orange accent. Same meaning and contrast pairs.

warning-subtle.$description: Quiet warning fill, in Ember's gold.

panel-warning.$description: Warning on dark panels, in Ember's gold.
